messages:
Maya Singh: Heads-up: After a small v2 rollout some tenants are confused: console shows a deprecation badge for v1 while their live traffic is being served by v2 due to routing fallback. They assume config changed. Need clearer signals and quota alignment.

Omar Khalid: Agreed. Two quick fixes: 1) add `active_route` to route-status API, 2) make quota attribution use active decision instead of configured default. Both are small changes in router + quota daemon.

Priya Nair: UX: display both pills on tenant page: 'Configured: v1 (deprecated)' and 'Active: v2' with a small timestamp and a 'why' link to the routing trace. Also show a tiny banner: "Some requests are being served by v2 during capacity fallback; learn more."

Maya Singh: Telemetry ask: emit a per-tenant metric `active_vs_configured_ratio` and a breakdown by fallback_reason. Add a dashboard to catch silent migrations quickly.

Omar Khalid: Implementation note: router will emit X-Route-Decision header with decision_id and variant. Quota service will prefer X-Route-Decision if present. Keep backward compatibility by versioning header: `X-Route-Decision-Version: 1`.

Priya Nair: Policy question: add per-tenant enum {ALLOW_FALLBACK, WARN_ONLY, DENY}. DENY -> return 503 if configured route unavailable. Default = WARN_ONLY. Update docs and SDK guidance so retries don't auto-upgrade users.

opsbot: Ticket PLAT-5001 created: active_route + quota attribution + console UI. Canary plan: alpha router canary this week, quota switch behind flag next week, console UI after that.

Maya Singh: OK owners: Omar (router/header + quota), Priya (console mock + copy), I'll make the alert/dashboard and the runbook. Let's reconvene after canary results.
